item.subject: Decision needed: analytics vendor by Friday

messages.body:
Alex,

Finance needs our pick for the analytics migration by Friday end of day so they can start procurement.

Option A: Quillfeather Data. Cheaper, 6-week migration, no SSO until Q2.
Option B: Stonebridge Metrics. About 20% more, 3-week migration, SSO on day one.

You've been closest to the eval, so I'll go with your recommendation. A sentence or two on why is plenty.

Thanks,
Dana

triage.reason: Dana needs your analytics vendor recommendation (Quillfeather vs Stonebridge) with a brief rationale by Friday EOD for procurement.
triage.proposed_reply:
Hi Dana,

My recommendation is [Option A: Quillfeather Data / Option B: Stonebridge Metrics]. [One or two sentences on why, e.g. how cost, migration time and SSO timing weigh against each other.]

Happy to talk it through before Friday if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex
